cpmb.label: CP S.S. Manitoba Cruise
cpmb.src: Canadian Pacific timetable, April 1948 (S.S. Manitoba, Great Lakes cruise), supplied by Brendan, 3 November 2026. Eastern Standard Time as printed, shown on the Pacific clock

stations.name: Port McNicoll
stations.note: Port McNicoll, Ont.: the steamer leaves directly from the C.P.R. station (Brendan)

stations.name: Owen Sound
stations.note: Owen Sound, Ont.: the C.P.R. station (Brendan), where the Toronto trains 707 and 708 connect with the steamer

stations.name: Sault Ste. Marie (C.S.L. Dock)
stations.note: Government Dock, Sault Ste. Marie, Ont. (Brendan); the Canada Steamship Lines dock, also called the Northern Navigation Dock, the Noronic's stop

trips.name: Great Lakes cruise
trips.note: S.S. Manitoba, outbound: Port McNicoll Thursday 4.00 p.m.; Owen Sound 10.00 p.m., leaving 11.00 p.m.; Sault Ste. Marie (Government Dock) Friday 7.30 p.m., leaving 8.00 p.m.; Fort William Saturday 5.00 p.m. Canadian Pacific S.S. Manitoba Great Lakes cruise, every Thursday June 24 to August 26 inclusive: Port McNicoll - Owen Sound (Toronto train 707 connects) - Sault Ste. Marie - Fort William and back, the ship lying at Fort William from Saturday 5.00 p.m. to Sunday 6.00 p.m. (the cruise fare includes meals and berth on ship at Fort William). Times printed in Eastern Standard Time and shown here in Pacific time, three hours earlier.
